narrative: The bill, on the bookwheel. A second black-letter bill. Title, house, and hour. No author's name. No sum. The bill, on the bookwheel. The lower line only. The paper stays on the table.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the title and kept north of the river.

entities.name: Hercules
entities.context: Shown on bill in Hercules, the second part
